line: The board thought they could bury the experiment. 58 floors up.
action: Pierce looking down from the 58th floor boardroom table, expression cold and authoritative.
why: Immediate hook establishing scale, height, and corporate hubris.

line: Push-in on the board meeting room. Papers scattered, shadows long, silence.
action: Empty chairs, scattered financial reports, dim lighting through towering glass windows overlooking the night skyline.
why: Establishes psychological dread and abandonment of control.

line: Pitch-black elevator shaft. Red warning lights pulsing. Screech of rusted cables going down.
action: Elevator descending rapidly past dark concrete floors, red emergency strobes flashing against Pierce's face.
why: Visual descent into the restricted basement levels.

line: Basement B3. Massive glass vat shattered from the inside. Something got out.
action: Pierce steps out onto B3. A giant glass containment vat is blown outward, fluid pooling on the lab floor, empty restraints swinging.
vfx: acid mist, shattered glass shards glistening
why: The central turning point where containment fails.

line: Pierce Hawkes staring into an office mirror, eyes glowing. Play PH Origins.
action: Transformed Pierce looking at his reflection in a dark office glass, eyes glowing with unearthly light.
why: Punchline / resolution: Pierce becomes the consequence of B3.
